scope:
Extract the supported reference while the other hand retracts the clamp.

The clamp is held forward, without the previously selected parking rotation.
The left hand first clears the optical face from the port, moves the reference
laterally out of the pad's projection, and withdraws it. This is a geometric
candidate; hand approaches, whole-body reach and contact forces are separate.
limitations: Local actual-mesh clearance only, with pre-established grasps.
No complete humanoid, arm approach, tool closure, retention-force or dynamic qualification.
